title: A-3A Gunnery Scope Presentation, B-52 no. 394 (second copy with handwritten number)
description: A second copy of the AF Form 112 radar scope chart from the 22d Bombardment Wing (M), titled "A-3A GUNNERY SCOPE PRESENTATION, B-52 ACFT. NUMBER 394." It shows the same annotations: a "Blip of unidentified aircraft" near the 6,000 range mark ("Smaller return than that produced by B-52"), a "Blip produced by second B-52 in cell" near 3,000, and a dashed arrow marked "Disappeared off scope." This copy has a handwritten circled "1" and a number in the lower right corner, and the struck-through SECRET markings at top and bottom.
